integrity.certification_limit: The attached finite checker supports only the enumerated dodecahedral combinatorics; no assertion of general/infinite computational certification is made.
integrity.method: Exact finite classification of a spherical great-circle arrangement, combined with a proved chamber-exhaustion criterion and Girard spherical excess.
integrity.reproducibility: Run the bundled standard-library Python program verify_dodecahedron_haar.py; the proof and complete quantified scope are in RESULT.md.

scientific_limitations: The result describes Haar-uniform central planes for the regular dodecahedron, not arbitrary affine offsets or other polyhedra.
Historical priority is not conclusively established: equivalently formulated older stereological or projection literature might contain the same probabilities.
A closely related central-icosahedron result was available as a searchable scientific summary but its full text was not inspected.
No independent mathematical audit or independent validation has been performed.
title: Exact Haar polygon-type law for central sections of the regular dodecahedron
